definition.summary: From an empty start, bootstrap raw materials and burner-era mining/smelting, get steam power running, and place a powered electric mining drill on the iron ore patch.

goal.objective: get steam power going and run an electric mining drill on iron ore

steps.description: Gather starter supplies near origin: 30 wood, 40 stone, 40 iron ore, 30 coal.
Craft stone furnace(s), smelt iron ore into iron plates with wood/coal fuel, verify plates.
Craft a burner mining drill from the smelted iron, verify it in inventory.
Place the burner drill on the coal patch, fuel it, and verify coal output.
Gather iron ore near base (~40).
Smelt iron ore into iron plates at the stone furnace until the steam-power trigger (50 iron plates crafted) is met.

Craft and place boiler + steam engine, supply water and coal, and verify power generation.
Craft an electric mining drill and place it on the iron ore patch, then verify it runs.
